title: Camera (anima/lora_dataset/camera.json)
description: Camera angle and distance tag definitions for Anima Aesthetic v1.1 LoRA dataset prompts. Tags: lowercase, spaces instead of underscores.

name.description: Stable identifier; used in filename_prefix. When positive is omitted or empty, name is the sole positive tag.

image_size.description: Output dimensions for this camera distance (width x height). Anima works between 512x512 and 1536x1536; each side must be a multiple of 16. Common sizes: 1:1 1024x1024, 2:3 832x1216, 3:2 1216x832, 3:4 896x1152, 4:3 1152x896, 9:16 768x1344, 16:9 1344x768.

image_dimension.description: Anima Aesthetic v1.1 pixel length. Multiple of 16, from 512 to 1536.

name.description: Stable identifier; used in filename_prefix. When positive is omitted or empty, name is the sole positive tag.
